source_title: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Now Accessible to Global Investors Outside the United States Through Binance's U.S. Stock Trading Service
source_excerpt:
FFR shares are now available to eligible users outside the United States through one of the world's largest digital-asset platforms using stablecoin .
LOS ANGELES , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR ) ("FFR" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based Embodied AI robotics company, today announced that its common stock is available for trading by eligible users through Binance 's U.S. stock trading service, which gives users in permitted jurisdictions outside the United States access to more than 7,000 U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs.
Eligible Binance users outside the U.S. can trade FFR shares alongside their digital assets in a single account as part of Binance 's U.S. equities offering.
Binance launched U.S. equities trading in June 2026 for eligible users in permitted jurisdictions, with orders routed and executed through its ADGM-regulated broker-dealer, Nest Trading Limited. The availability of FFR shares through the service is determined solely by Binance and its affiliates and does not constitute an endorsement by Binance .
"The availability of FFR on Binance 's U.S. stock trading service expands access to the Company's investment story, enabling a broader audience of eligible investors to participate in the FF AI and Robotics ecosystem," said Jerry Wang, Executive Chairman of FFR.
At its October 26 deal closing and first Investor Day in New York, FFR announced that it had completed its acquisition of Faraday Future's robotics business on October 23. The related business operations and assets were transferred to FFR. Following the transaction, FFR continues trading on Nasdaq as a company focused on humanoid and bionic Physical AI robotics, built around its Four-Core Full-Stack AI ecosystem.
FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR ) is a U.S.-based Embodied AI robotics company focused on the research and development, manufacturing, commercialization and deployment of intelligent robotic technologies, products and industry solutions. FFR is building a "Four-Core Full-Stack" AI ecosystem covering the full lifecycle of robotics, consisting of EAI Brain & Developer Platform, EAI Devices, Industry Productivity Solutions, and EAI Data Factory. Guided by the technology and product philosophy of "One Brain, Multi-forms, Multi-capabilities," FFR aims to empower humanoid, biomimetic, and other robotic form factors through a unified EAI Brain, while continuously expanding their multi-task and multi-scenario capabilities. The ecosystem is designed to support the full robotics lifecycle, including R&D, deployment, data collection and training, operations, and commercial applications. FFR also operates RoboShare, a robot-sharing and services platform.
